关于公交车站的故事(A Story about the bus stop): 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:艾米与安娜的经历和小计划。
Life is full of small surprises. Amy thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Amy is going to travel to Rome in November. I could hardly recognise the town after ten years.
Amy's favorite animal is the panda. Amy and Anna had great fun there. They took many photos at the old town. Best of all, the campfire glow lit up our happy faces.
Amy borrowed a book about English from the museum. Both of them like bread and coffee. Amy wrote about the day in the diary. In fact, I could hear the soft ticking of the old clock.
There are always many people at the old town. Last Monday, Amy and Anna went to the bus stop. Amy learned a lot about English.
